Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified Lion Air's main airport as Don Mueang International Airport in Bangkok, Thailand, instead of Soekarno-Hatta International Airport in Indonesia. This misidentification led to the Planner incorrectly determining the country as Thailand and subsequently providing the wrong former name, Siam, instead of the correct Dutch East Indies.
